verse.verse_2: Who has gathered wealth and counted it.
verse.verse_3: He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!
verse.verse_4: But no! Verily, he will be thrown into Al-Hutamah.
verse.verse_5: And what will make you know what Al-Hutamah is
verse.verse_7: Which leaps up over the hearts.
verse.verse_8: Verily, it shall Mu'sadah upon them,
